verdict.rationale: Paxos exposes a broad API surface (identities, transfers, fiat, orchestrations, crypto brokerage, FIX, WebSocket) covering most core platform actions, suggesting general API/UI parity intent. However, several workflows (webhook configuration, viewing webhooks, the Dashboard 'Fund' button) are described as Dashboard-only steps with no documented API equivalent shown, and no OpenAPI spec was discoverable to confirm full API coverage. Missing for 10: explicit statement or evidence of full API/UI parity, an API endpoint for webhook creation/management, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec confirming completeness.
